title: YETI Rambler 20 oz Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Tumbler w/MagSlider Lid

reviews.title: Durable, Stylish, and Keeps Drinks Cold All Day
reviews.body: I’m extremely happy with this YETI Rambler. The quality is excellent, and it keeps my cold beverages ice cold for around 12 hours. Even after several hours, there’s still ice left in the cup, which is impressive. It also fits perfectly in my car’s cup holder, making it great for commuting, running errands, or road trips.The tumbler feels sturdy, is easy to clean, and the lid helps prevent spills while on the go. The color is beautiful, and it looks just as nice in person as it does online. Although it’s more expensive than some other tumblers, the performance and durability make it well worth the investment. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable, high-quality insulated tumbler.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2026
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Best brand for your money!
reviews.body: Yeti is just top quality when it comes to keeping your drinks warm or cold.  The color is beautiful and fits in the cup holder in my car.  It’s so easy to use and clean and the best part is your hands will not get cold holding the cup!  It’s also durable and will last for a long time so definitely worth the money!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 21, 2026
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: This Yeti cup is excellent and lives up to the hype. It keeps drinks cold for hours on end and hot beverages stay warm far longer than expected. The build quality feels extremely solid, with a durable exterior that can handle drops, bumps, and everyday abuse without issue. The lid fits securely, helping prevent spills, and the design is easy to hold and use on the go. It’s perfect for travel, work, outdoor activities, or just daily use at home. Overall, it’s a high-quality, reliable cup that performs exactly as promised and is absolutely worth it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 21, 2026
reviews.author: Randy needham

reviews.title: Literally the best cup I own
reviews.body: This is easily the best cup I own. I use it constantly, especially at the beach, pool, and lake, and it keeps drinks cold for an absurd amount of time.The insulation is the real selling point. I left it sitting on my counter with nothing but ice in it, and there was still ice in the cup the next afternoon. That’s not “kind of works” territory. That’s ridiculous in the best way.It’s also just a great size. Big enough that I’m not constantly refilling it, but still easy to carry around and use on the go. The MagSlider lid is convenient, the cup feels sturdy, and it has held up well so far.It’s not the cheapest tumbler, but after using it, I get the hype. This is one of those things I bought once and immediately understood why people swear by YETI.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2026
reviews.author: Matt & Melissa

reviews.title: Great travel mug
reviews.body: Perfect insulated mug for hot and cold. Keeps either cold or hot for hours. This cup is perfect because it does fit in the car cupholder. The only downfall is there is no handle and it does spill.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 30, 2026
reviews.author: Nicole  W

reviews.title: Great design
reviews.body: Love everything about it. I always take a glass of water to bed. I must take medication during the night so it doesn’t’ effect other meds I need to take later. The tumbler is very sturdy, great looking and keeps my water cold. The magnetic cover over the spout works so easy. It can be removed to clean the lid thoroughly. I like that the lid does prevent most of the water from leaking out if it is knocked over. It is not water tight.This Tumbler is great if you need a refreshing drink during the night.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 26, 2026
reviews.author: M. Stefanowicz

features: These Ramblers come standard with our YETI MagSlider Lid, the only drink lid that uses the power of magnets to keep your water, beer, or favorite drink on lock
Our Ramblers are BPA-free, dishwasher safe, and have a No Sweat Design to make sure your hands stay dry
Dracut is a durable coat of color that won't fade, peel, or crack through extended field use and also provide additional grip to the Rambler's exterior
We over-engineered these double-wall insulated tumblers with an 18/8 stainless steel body, which means your drink still keeps its temperature no matter how much of a beating this cup takes
The YETI 20 oz. Rambler Tumbler stands 6 7/8 in high and has a lip diameter of 3 1/2 in. All YETI Tumblers are sized to fit in standard sized cup holders
Sport type: Camping & Hiking. Keeps cold drinks cold and hot drinks hot until the last sip
